capabilities.description: Movie and film metadata lookup — titles, cast, ratings, and database records from movie catalogs. Use when an agent resolves film identity or enriches entertainment context.

capabilities.description: Current news headlines and topical news feeds across tech, business, science, crypto, sports, and world news. Use when an agent needs headline summaries, not long-form cited research (ai.web_research).

capabilities.description: Podcast directory search and show/episode metadata lookup by name, feed URL, or free-text query — matching shows, host and listener details, recent episodes, and RSS/iTunes feed records. capabilities.label: Get live and historical sports scores and schedules
capabilities.description: Sports scores, schedules, standings, and match results across leagues. Use when an agent answers sports outcome questions or monitors fixtures.

capabilities.description: Find property listings, rental comps, and home value estimates. Use when an agent needs residential sale or rental listings for a city, zip, or neighborhood to answer relocation, investment, or housing budget questions.

capabilities.description: Regulatory drug-label lookup — FDA-approved indications, dosage, warnings, adverse reactions, and manufacturer details by brand or generic name from official pharmaceutical registries.
